d: Jesús Owono is facing an extremely difficult period after the death of teammate Jesús de Miguel following an on-field collision in a match between Tenerife and FC Andorra. But the Equatorial Guinea goalkeeper has also had to deal with online abuse, with social media users directing blame and accusations towards him despite the incident being a sporting accident. Owono has now issued his first statement, speaking about his grief and his struggle to process the tragedy.
